name: io.github.EvidInvest/aether-developer
description: Agent-native search engine for SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, S&P 500 x 10y), earnings-call transcripts, and EU financial regulation. Every result is a citation-complete payload — exact section text, accession-numbered citation, sec.gov source URL — ready to use as evidence, no HTML parsing. Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + cross-encoder) plus a two-sided financial-data marketplace. Free 3-month trial, no card.

environmentVariables.name: AETHER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Aether API key (ak_…). If unset, the package runs OAuth 2.0 device flow on first run. Get keys at https://aether.evidinvest.com/developer/keys.
